From 582838ea5bea41258d136c82a6c493a95cda652c Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Geert Uytterhoeven <geert+renesas@glider.be>
Date: Mon, 11 May 2020 12:18:28 +0200
Subject: [PATCH] gpiolib: Document that GPIO line names are not globally
 unique

gpiochip_set_desc_names() no longer rejects GPIO line name collisions.
Hence GPIO line names are not guaranteed to be globally unique.
In case of multiple GPIO lines with the same name, gpio_name_to_desc()
will return the first match found.

Update the comments for gpio_name_to_desc() and
gpiochip_set_desc_names() to match reality.

Fixes: f881bab038c9667d ("gpio: keep the GPIO line names internal")
Signed-off-by: Geert Uytterhoeven <geert+renesas@glider.be>
Link: https://lore.kernel.org/r/20200511101828.30046-1-geert+renesas@glider.be
Signed-off-by: Linus Walleij <linus.walleij@linaro.org>

diff --git a/drivers/gpio/gpiolib.c b/drivers/gpio/gpiolib.c
index 48b4f70e2898..fe5f14a417bd 100644
--- a/drivers/gpio/gpiolib.c
+++ b/drivers/gpio/gpiolib.c
@@ -296,6 +296,9 @@ static int gpiodev_add_to_list(struct gpio_device *gdev)
 
 /*
  * Convert a GPIO name to its descriptor
+ * Note that there is no guarantee that GPIO names are globally unique!
+ * Hence this function will return, if it exists, a reference to the first GPIO
+ * line found that matches the given name.
  */
 static struct gpio_desc *gpio_name_to_desc(const char * const name)
 {
@@ -329,10 +332,12 @@ static struct gpio_desc *gpio_name_to_desc(const char * const name)
 }
 
 /*
- * Takes the names from gc->names and checks if they are all unique. If they
- * are, they are assigned to their gpio descriptors.
+ * Take the names from gc->names and assign them to their GPIO descriptors.
+ * Warn if a name is already used for a GPIO line on a different GPIO chip.
  *
- * Warning if one of the names is already used for a different GPIO.
+ * Note that:
+ *   1. Non-unique names are still accepted,
+ *   2. Name collisions within the same GPIO chip are not reported.
  */
 static int gpiochip_set_desc_names(struct gpio_chip *gc)
 {
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `drivers/gpio/gpiolib.c`**
   - **Function: `gpio_name_to_desc()`**
     - Updated comments to clarify that GPIO names are not guaranteed to be globally unique.
     - Added a note that the function will return a reference to the first GPIO line found that matches the given name, if it exists.

   - **Function: `gpiochip_set_desc_names()`**
     - Revised comments to indicate that names from `gc->names` are assigned to GPIO descriptors without enforcing uniqueness.
     - Added a warning that non-unique names are accepted and that name collisions within the same GPIO chip are not reported.

### Relationships Between Modifications

The modifications in `gpio_name_to_desc()` and `gpiochip_set_desc_names()` are interrelated as they both address the handling of GPIO line names. The changes in `gpio_name_to_desc()` clarify the behavior of the function in the context of non-unique names, while the updates in `gpiochip_set_desc_names()` reflect the acceptance of non-unique names and the lack of collision reporting. Together, these changes ensure that the documentation accurately represents the current functionality and behavior of the GPIO line naming system, following the removal of the uniqueness requirement.

The root cause of the bug is that the function `gpiochip_set_desc_names()` no longer enforces uniqueness for GPIO line names, allowing multiple GPIO lines to have the same name. This change means that when looking up GPIO lines by name using `gpio_name_to_desc()`, there is no guarantee that the correct line will be returned, as it will return the first match found, potentially leading to unexpected behavior when multiple lines share the same name.
